# U185: A verifier’s Home: as Amara, Home says “5 metrics to verify” under Metrics to verify, names the three soonest, each opening its page where she can verify it, and “2 more in To verify” opens the library’s To verify; Rhea, who may verify none, sees no such line; with the Metric library switched off, Amara’s Home has none either

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-VERIFY`
- **Budget:** at most 8 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U185

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “5 metrics to verify” is shown in the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`) (else: Home does not say how many metrics Amara may verify).
- **Check:** (`entry`) a link in the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`honest`) there are 3 of the list item (`li`) in the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`) and the svg (`svg`) in the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`) is not there (else: Home lists more or fewer than three metrics to verify, or marks them with a shape).
- **Step.** Press the {first} link in the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`).
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** “Verify (this metric / again)” is shown (else: {first}’s page does not offer to verify it).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “to verify”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “2 more in To verify” link in the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`).
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ Rhea may verify none of them: no line.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(k) => localStorage.setItem(k, 'rhea')`, given `'goals-app-viewer:platform-org'`.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- **Check:** “Rhea” is shown in Home (else: Home did not open as Rhea).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`) is not there (else: Rhea, who may verify no metric, is told there are metrics to verify).
- _Note:_ The Metric library off: nothing on Amara's Home either.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(k) => localStorage.setItem(k, 'amara')`, given `'goals-app-viewer:platform-org'`.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Metric” tick box.
- **Check:** “Metric library is off in” is shown (else: the Metric library does not switch off).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- **Check:** (`logged`) the “Metrics to verify” part (`[data-part="Metrics to verify"]`) is not there (else: Home says there are metrics to verify with the Metric library off).
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
